setup: Lie on a flat bench with feet supported; retain head, shoulder and butt contact.
Use a closed palms-forward grip, neutral wrists and shoulders down/back; signal a spotter for assistance.
executionSteps: Inhale and lower both dumbbells slowly toward the mid-chest without bouncing or changing bench contact.
Exhale while pressing to elbow extension, maintaining neutral wrists and supported contact.
technique.finishOrReset: Signal the spotter and retain your grip until the dumbbells are taken.

mistakes.mistake: Bouncing or losing the described points of contact.
mistakes.correction: Reset supported contact and controlled movement.

setup: Start with feet together, shoulders down/back and trunk braced.
executionSteps: Lift one foot while controlling balance, then step forward heel-first and transfer weight onto the planted foot.
Lower the hips toward the floor to a comfortable position, bending at the hips with a flat back; avoid sideways sway.
Push through the front leg to return upright.
technique.finishOrReset: Return to the initial stance before the next step.
keyCheckpoints: Control the supporting leg and torso.

mistakes.correction: Return to stable balance before continuing.

setup: Stand hip-width with knees slightly bent, holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of the thighs.
executionSteps: Move the hips back while keeping the spine long, chin tucked and knees slightly bent.
Lower until tension is felt behind the thighs; the endpoint varies with controlled hip motion. Look toward the floor.
Drive through the heels and bring the hips forward to stand, retaining a long spine.
technique.finishOrReset: Return the dumbbells to the front of the thighs.
keyCheckpoints: Move through the hips rather than rounding the lower back.

mistakes.mistake: Rounding the back or turning the hinge into a squat.
mistakes.correction: Practise the unloaded hip hinge with qualified instruction.
